newsitem.title: USA: Truck-bus crash in Texas kills three.
newsitem.headline: Truck-bus crash in Texas kills three.

text.p: Three people were killed and 14 people injured Wednesday when a pickup truck slammed into two Greyhound buses on an ice-slickened highway, police said.

A spokesman for the Texas Department of Public Safety said the truck spun out of control after it crossed an icy bridge on Interstate 10 and went into the opposite lane where it sideswiped one bus and ran head-on into another.
The two buses, each carrying more than 40 passengers, were going west on the highway in a rural area about 30 miles northwest of Kerrville.

The DPS spokesman said the dead were all passengers in the pickup truck and included a child. He said two of the injured were in critical condition and flown to a hospital in San Antonio, which is 60 miles southwest of Kerrville.
Much of Texas was covered with ice and snow this week after a winter storm passed through the state.
